requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed moving model performance monitoring to a governed state.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Moving monitoring to governed is a start, but it still leaves us blind to the silent drift that hits the middle aisle allocations before the leaflet goes out. I need the feedback loop to trigger an automatic rollback to the last known good forecast if the error spikes during the morning order window.
output.correction: You are treating this as a compliance checkbox, but I am talking about operational resilience for the store managers who are currently overriding orders because they do not trust the numbers. The goal is to stop the system from serving stale or broken forecasts when the till data is late.
